description: Procurement profile of a contracting authority from its TED notices: notice counts by type (calls, awards, amendments, prior information), the most recent notices, CPV divisions and procedure types in the recent sample, name variants and identifiers seen, first and last publication in the sample. Sample size and coverage are stated with every aggregate. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_authority"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/authority?name=Ministry+of+Finance&country=RS

name.description: authority name or part of it (required), e.g. Ministry of Finance
